messages.subject: Project Atlas - mutual NDA for signature
messages.plaintextBody:
Charles,

Good to speak earlier. As discussed, I attach the mutual non-disclosure agreement for the proposed acquisition of Brampton Leisure. It is on standard terms - 2 year duration, mutual, with a 12-month non-solicit of their senior team. Once you are happy, please arrange signature and we will get it counter-signed by Brampton so we can open the data room.

Kind regards,
Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
